I have grown crops on this small plot for many years using only the seeds I save from last season, because I have no schooling and little money for shop-bought inputs. Here in Mtwara the soil is sandy and the rains come twice, so I plant local cassava and beans together to be sure my family has food even when times are hard. My sons and their children help me with the digging and weeding when they can, but we never hire workers from outside since our pockets are empty, and I do not trust chemical fertilizers or sprays.
